ui.cash_tooltip: Cash on this board. Open Company for your shared bank balance.
ui.buy_pack: Buy this pack. Cards are placed on your table.
ui.not_possible: That action is not available yet.
ui.ideas_intro: Stack ingredients on the root card. Workers and equipment remain; ingredients are consumed. Discovered Ideas are permanent.
ui.goals_intro: A small company, one good decision at a time. Complete milestones to discover new packs and equipment.
ui.controls:
Drag cards together to work. Drag a root to move its stack. Shift-drag or Separate to remove one card. Right-click a card for actions.

Mouse wheel: zoom
Middle mouse / right-drag empty table: pan
Space: pause / resume
1 / 2 / 3: speed
Home: return to table
I: Ideas · G: Goals
Esc: menu
ui.survival_help: Reserve cash for rent and wages before expanding. Let stressed workers take a break. Keep your receipts and prepare for inspections. Your Founder always has a way back.
ui.new_warning: Your current company is saved. Starting a new company will replace the autosave when it is saved.
ui.easy_desc: Room to learn, recover and grow. Recommended for your first company.
ui.medium_desc: A tighter budget. Balance growth with the next payroll.
ui.hard_desc: Little room for waste. Keep a reserve and respond early.
ui.guided_start: Show helpful tips as I play
ui.menu_footer: Build a business at your own pace. Pause any time.
ui.load_failed: This save could not be opened. Your file has been kept.
ui.save_failed: Could not save. Please check available disk space.
ui.tip1: Press Space to pause. You can still move cards and plan your next move.
ui.tip2: Drag Founder onto Old Laptop, then add Freelance Contract. The stack starts working when the recipe matches.
ui.tip3: Look in Ideas for recipes. Drag a finished product to the Sell stamp at the right edge.
ui.tip4: Choose a pack above the table. Each pack focuses on a different part of your company. Keep money for payroll.
ui.tip5: The top bar shows your deadline. Select an invoice to pay it, or use Company → Pay outstanding invoices.
ui.tip6: Select a person and choose Rest. Coffee helps too. High Stress slows work and may cause Burnout.
ui.tip7: Discover Idea cards to keep recipes permanently. Follow Goals toward Series A, then expand at your own pace.
ui.tip8: Zoom with the mouse wheel. Pan with middle mouse or right-drag. Shift-drag separates a card. Press Home to return.

ui.practice_done: You're ready to build your own company.
ui.practice_done_desc: You have learned how to stack, produce, trade, pay bills and look after your team. Your saved company is unchanged.
ui.practice_no_save: Practice stays separate. Your saved company is unchanged.
ui.practice1: Press Space or Pause. Practice is separate from your saved company. When you're ready, resume at 1× or 2×.
ui.practice2: Stack Founder + Freelance Contract on Old Laptop. Resume time and wait for the payment. Shift-drag separates a card.
ui.practice3: Separate Founder from the laptop, then stack Founder + Marker on Whiteboard. Wait for your Concept.
ui.practice4: Place Developer + Concept on Old Laptop. Wait for the Prototype. You can select the laptop to see recipe actions.
ui.practice5: Drag the finished Prototype to the Sell stamp on the right. The payment appears as real cash cards.
ui.practice6: Choose Early Leads above the table. Packs add new cards, so watch the card limit and keep cash for bills.
ui.practice7: Select the practice invoice and choose Pay invoice. Company → Pay outstanding invoices can settle several bills.
ui.practice8: Select Developer and choose Rest. A short break lowers Stress. Coffee can also help a tired person.
ui.practice9: Select the golden Idea card and choose Discover. Its recipe stays in Ideas and the card leaves the table.
